reasoning: Selected 3,163,774. Both incurred and paid are fully developed (CDF=1.0, 287 months mature); incurred actual is used as final since the ~121K gap to paid reflects open case reserves not yet disbursed rather than remaining liability uncertainty. CL/IE/BF all collapse to the same value at this maturity, so credibility is effectively 100% on the reported incurred figure. No prior available (first-time analysis).

Selected 2,327,734. Incurred is fully developed (CDF=1.0); the gap to paid actual (2,199,646) is unpaid case reserve, not IBNR. IE (2,904,344) is disregarded as it materially overstates a fully known outcome, confirming IE is not well-calibrated for this book. CL on incurred is fully credible here. No prior available.

Selected 1,778,092. Incurred and paid actuals are identical and both fully developed (CDF=1.0) — claims are closed with no case reserve left. This is a certain outcome, so CL/IE/BF distinctions are moot. No prior available.

Selected 1,142,000, the average of incurred CL (1,141,699) and paid CL (1,142,943), which agree almost exactly at 98%+ developed. High credibility on CL from both bases; IE (1,678,711) is again well above the converged CL result and is given no weight, consistent with IE running too high/uncalibrated for this book. No prior available.

Selected 2,292,000, averaging incurred CL (2,289,387) and paid CL (2,294,164), which are tightly aligned at ~98% developed. Both bases confirm the same ultimate; IE actually swings negative here (implying negative IBNR) and is not used. No prior available.

Selected 1,554,000, averaging incurred CL (1,536,905) and paid CL (1,571,031), consistent at ~88-90% developed. IE (1,227,804) understates and is not used. No prior available.
